about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Shami Kebab Lahori Lamb and Lentil Patties
recipes.summary: Soft pan-fried patties of minced lamb and chana dal with warm spices, served with mint yoghurt and flatbread.
steps: Simmer the lamb, lentils, onion, garlic, cumin, garam masala, 1 tsp salt and 1 cup water for 20 minutes until the water has gone and the lentils are soft.
Cool slightly, mince in a food processor until paste-like, then mix in the egg.
Shape into 12 patties and chill for 10 minutes so they hold together.
Fry in the oil for 3 minutes each side until browned and crisp.
Stir the mint into the yoghurt and serve with the patties and warm flatbreads.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until it reaches 75°C throughout, and the egg until set. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Malai Boti Lahori Creamy Chicken Skewers
recipes.summary: Mild chicken marinated in cream, yoghurt and white pepper then grilled, with rice and a squeeze of lemon.

items: 700g boneless chicken breast, cut in chunks

steps: Mix the chicken with the cream, yoghurt, ginger, garlic, pepper, garam masala and 1 tsp salt, and thread onto skewers.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Grill over medium-high heat for 12 minutes, turning, until golden at the edges and cooked through.
Serve with the rice and lemon wedges for squeezing over.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lahori Fried Fish with Chickpea Flour Crust
recipes.summary: Firm white fish in a spiced chickpea flour coating, fried until crisp, with lemon and mint yoghurt.

items: 700g white fish fillet, cut in strips

steps: Toss the fish with the lemon juice and 1/2 tsp salt.
Mix the chickpea flour, cornflour and spices with 1/3 cup water into a thick batter and coat the fish.
Shallow-fry the fish in batches for 3 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Drain on paper and stir the mint into the yoghurt to serve alongside.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C at the centre. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chopan Kebab Afghan Lamb Chops with Flatbread
recipes.summary: Simple salt, pepper and onion lamb cutlets grilled until crusty, served with flatbread and grilled tomato.
steps: Rub the cutlets with the onion, garlic, coriander, pepper, oil and 1 tsp salt.
Grill the tomatoes cut-side down for 6 minutes until blistered.
Grill the cutlets over high heat for 4 minutes each side until browned and cooked to your liking.
Rest the lamb for 3 minutes and serve with the tomatoes and warmed flatbreads.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until it reaches 63°C at the thickest point, with 3 minutes rest. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Bolani Afghan Potato and Chive Stuffed Flatbread
recipes.summary: Thin fried flatbreads filled with mashed potato, chives and cumin, served with yoghurt and a tomato salsa.
steps: Mix the flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 tbsp oil and 3/4 cup warm water into a soft dough, then rest 20 minutes.
Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes until soft, drain and mash with the chives, cumin, chilli and a pinch of salt.
Divide the dough into 4, roll thin, spread half of each round with filling, fold over and seal.
Fry in the remaining oil for 3 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Serve with the yoghurt and diced tomato.

recipes.title: Sekuwa Nepali Charcoal-Style Grilled Pork
recipes.summary: Smoky pork pieces rubbed with ginger, garlic, timur-style pepper and mustard oil, grilled and served with rice.
steps: Rub the pork with the oil, ginger, garlic, spices and 1 tsp salt.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Grill or roast the pork at 220°C for 20 minutes, turning, until browned and tender.
Squeeze over the lemon and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C in the thickest piece. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Dal Bhat Nepali Lentil Plate with Spinach and Potato Tarkari
recipes.summary: Lentil soup poured over rice, with a mild spiced potato and spinach side, and a squeeze of lime.
steps: Simmer the lentils with the turmeric and 3 cups water for 20 minutes until soft, then season with salt.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Fry the onion, garlic and cumin in the oil for 5 minutes, add the potatoes and 1/2 cup water and cook for 12 minutes until tender.
Stir in the spinach for 2 minutes until wilted.
Serve the rice with the dal and tarkari, with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Thukpa Nepali Chicken Noodle Curry
recipes.summary: A warming bowl of chicken, noodles and vegetables in a mild ginger and tomato broth.
steps: Fry the onion, ginger and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the cumin and tomatoes for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and 5 cups water and simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the carrots and cabbage and simmer for 5 minutes until tender.
Boil the noodles separately for 4 minutes, drain and divide among bowls.
Ladle over the broth and finish with the soy sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Contains egg. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mappas Kerala Chicken in Gentle Coconut Gravy
recipes.summary: A mild coconut milk chicken stew with potatoes, peppercorns and cardamom, served with rice.

items: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps: Soften the onion, ginger and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the chicken, potatoes, pepper, cardamom and 1 tsp salt and cook for 4 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and 1/2 cup water and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken and potato are tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve the stew over it.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Kerala Vegetable Stew with Appam-Style Pancakes
recipes.summary: Vegetables in a mild coconut milk stew served with soft rice-flour pancakes.
steps: Whisk the rice flour, yeast, sugar, a pinch of salt and 1 1/4 cups warm water into a batter, then rest for 1 hour.
Soften the onion and ginger in the oil for 5 minutes, add the potatoes, carrots, pepper and 1 cup water, and cook 12 minutes until tender.
Add the beans and coconut milk and simmer for 6 minutes until the beans are tender.
Pour small ladles of batter into a hot non-stick pan, swirl and cook covered for 2 minutes until set and lacy at the edges.
Serve the pancakes with the stew.

recipes.title: Bhapa Maach Bengali Steamed Mustard Fish Parcels
recipes.summary: Fish pieces steamed with mustard paste and green chilli in foil parcels, served with rice.

items: 600g white fish fillet, cut in pieces

steps: Blend the mustard seeds, chillies, coconut and 1/3 cup water into a coarse paste, then stir in the turmeric, oil and 1 tsp salt.
Coat the fish and wrap in foil or banana leaf parcels.
Steam for 15 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the parcels.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Kosha Mangsho Bengali Slow-Cooked Lamb Curry
recipes.summary: Lamb slowly browned with onions and spices until the sauce clings, served with rice.
steps: Brown the onions in the oil for 15 minutes until deep golden.
Add the ginger, garlic, spices and yoghurt and cook for 5 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the lamb and cook 10 minutes, then add 1 cup water and the potatoes, cover and simmer for 1 hour until tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, then serve with the curry.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Hyderabadi Chicken Dum Biryani
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken and fragrant rice layered and steamed together under a tight lid.

items: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps: Brown the onions in the oil for 15 minutes until deep golden, then set half aside.
Add the ginger, garlic, spices, yoghurt, chicken and 1 tsp salt to the remaining onions and cook 12 minutes.
Boil the rice in salted water for 5 minutes until just par-cooked, then drain.
Layer the rice over the chicken with the mint and reserved onions, cover tightly and cook on low heat for 25 minutes until the rice is tender.
Fluff gently with a fork and serve straight from the pot.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Lucknowi Chicken Korma Mild Almond Curry
recipes.summary: A creamy, mild chicken curry with yoghurt and ground almonds, good for children, served with rice.

items: 700g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps: Soften the onions in the butter for 10 minutes without browning, then add the ginger, garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and brown lightly for 5 minutes.
Stir in the yoghurt, almonds and 1 cup water and simmer for 20 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the curry.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Kadhi Pakora Punjabi Yoghurt Curry with Chickpea Fritters
recipes.summary: A tangy turmeric yoghurt curry holding soft onion fritters, served with rice.
steps: Whisk the yoghurt, 1/4 cup chickpea flour, turmeric and 3 cups water until smooth, then simmer for 25 minutes, stirring, until thickened.
Mix the remaining chickpea flour with the onion, half the cumin, 1/2 tsp salt and 3 tbsp water into a thick batter.
Fry spoonfuls in 2 tbsp oil for 3 minutes each side until golden, then add to the kadhi.
Heat the last tbsp oil, sizzle the mustard seeds, cumin and chilli for 30 seconds and pour over.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the kadhi.

recipes.title: Gujarati Vegetarian Thali with Dal, Potato Curry and Rotis
recipes.summary: A balanced plate of sweet-sour dal, spiced potato and cauliflower and soft rotis.
steps: Simmer the lentils with the turmeric and 3 cups water for 20 minutes until soft, then stir in the sugar, lemon juice and salt.
Knead the flour with 1/2 cup water and 1 tbsp oil, rest 10 minutes, then roll into 8 thin rounds.
Sizzle the mustard seeds and cumin in the remaining oil, add the potatoes, cauliflower and 1/2 cup water, and cook covered 15 minutes until tender.
Cook the rotis in a dry pan for 1 minute each side until blistered.
Serve everything on a plate.

recipes.title: Pav Bhaji Mumbai Spiced Vegetable Mash with Buttered Rolls
recipes.summary: A buttery spiced tomato and vegetable mash scooped up with toasted rolls.
steps: Boil the potatoes and cauliflower for 12 minutes until soft, then drain.
Fry the onion and capsicum in 2 tbsp butter for 6 minutes, add the tomatoes and spices and cook 8 minutes until pulpy.
Add the boiled vegetables and peas, mash roughly while cooking 8 minutes until thick.
Toast the split rolls in the remaining butter until golden.
Serve the bhaji with the rolls and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Galle-Style Ambul Thiyal Peppery Sour Fish
recipes.summary: Dry-style fish curry cooked with black pepper and tamarind, served with rice.

items: 600g white fish fillet, cut in chunks

steps: Mix the tamarind, pepper, turmeric, garlic, ginger, 1 tsp salt and 1/2 cup water.
Add the fish and simmer gently for 20 minutes until the liquid has reduced and clings.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Stir in the oil and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and it reaches 63°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tehari Dhaka Beef and Potato Rice
recipes.summary: Aromatic rice cooked with tender beef, potato and mustard oil, Dhaka style.
steps: Brown the onions in the oil for 12 minutes, then add the ginger, garlic and spices for 2 minutes.
Add the beef and 1 tsp salt and cook 8 minutes, then add 2 cups water, cover and simmer for 40 minutes until tender.
Add the potatoes, rice and 2 more cups water and simmer covered 15 minutes until the rice is tender.
Rest covered for 5 minutes before fluffing.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Murgir Jhol Bangladeshi Home-Style Chicken Curry
recipes.summary: A light, thin-gravy chicken and potato curry for everyday rice.
steps: Brown the onions in the oil for 10 minutes, then add the ginger, garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook 6 minutes, then add the potatoes, 2 cups water and 1 tsp salt.
Cover and simmer for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the potato tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the curry.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C near the bone. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Tandoori Prawns with Mint Chutney Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Prawns in a spiced yoghurt coating grilled until charred at the edges.
steps: Mix the prawns with half the yoghurt, ginger, garlic, spices, oil, lemon juice and 1/2 tsp salt.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy.
Grill the prawns on skewers for 5 minutes, turning, until pink and lightly charred.
Stir the mint into the remaining yoghurt and serve with the prawns and rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and firm, about 63°C inside. Contains shellfish. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Kashmiri Rogan Josh Lamb Curry
recipes.summary: Lamb slowly cooked in a ginger, fennel and chilli yoghurt gravy with a deep red colour.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil for 8 minutes in batches, then remove.
Soften the onions in the same pot for 8 minutes, add the ginger, garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Return the lamb with the yoghurt and 1 cup water, cover, and simmer for 1 hour until tender.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve with the curry.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until it reaches 75°C and is tender. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Mangalorean Chicken Ghee Roast
recipes.summary: Chicken in a dry-roasted red chilli and spice paste cooked in ghee until sticky.

items: 800g boneless chicken thighs, cut in chunks

steps: Soak the chillies in hot water 10 minutes, then blend with the spices, tamarind and garlic into a paste.
Rub the chicken with the paste and 1 tsp salt.
Cook the chicken in the ghee over medium heat for 25 minutes, stirring, until dark and the oil clings.
Stir in the sugar and cook for 2 minutes.
Cook the rice until tender and fluffy, and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour.
